newsitem.title: CANADA: B.C. Muni Finance Authority sets C$100 mln bond.
newsitem.headline: B.C. Muni Finance Authority sets C$100 mln bond.

text.p: The Municipal Finance Authority of British Columbia on Tuesday issued a C$100 million, 7.25 percent bond due September 25, 2006, said lead manager RBC Dominion Securities Inc.
The issue was priced at C$98.81 with a yield of 7.421 percent and a spread of about 21 basis points over the Government of Canada 8.75 percent bond due December, 2005.
The issue will be delivered on September 25 and pays interest on September 25 and March 25.
